findings.description: The `afterAll(endSandboxRun)` comment still says 'The gate children this file runs', but the file is now a helper that runs none. The hook now registers only as a side effect of a shard importing this module, and nothing at the import site says so. A future shard that runs gate children without importing a value from here (or with only `import type`, which `verbatimModuleSyntax` drops) silently loses the cleanup. Reword it to say 'Every shard that imports this file ...' or say it at the import site.

Each shard re-declares the same `CLI commands` harness (the ~35-line `beforeEach`, the ~15-line `afterEach`, `useCwd`), and `onPlatform` is copied into both index-2.test.ts (L265-275) and index-3.test.ts (L302-312). None of this is forced by `vi.mock` hoisting. The copies match today, but the next env hazard has to be added in three places. A follow-up `useCliHarness()` in src/test/helpers/cli-index.mock.ts could hold them.

The shard names `index-2`/`index-3` don't say what they hold, and nothing records that the split is by measured duration. The repo's existing split uses topic suffixes (`web-dashboard-health.test.ts`, `web-dashboard-debt.test.ts`). Either use topic names, or add a short header in each shard saying how to place a new describe.

`HANDOFF_WAIT_DEFAULT_MS`, `unreadableEventsFile` and `seedDeadTurn` are exported from the shared helper, but only index-3.test.ts uses them. testing.md says 'a double only one suite needs stays in that suite', so they belong as locals in index-3.

`GIT_ENV`, `initRepo` and `firstCall` have nothing to do with the CLI index. `GIT_ENV` is copied locally in about 20 other suites, for example `src/core/merge-gate.test.ts` L148, `src/core/review.test.ts` L20 and `src/cli/project-utils.test.ts` L19. Exporting the first shared copy from a file named `cli-index.mock.ts` makes the eventual canonical helper hard to find and suggests it is scoped to one test. Those copies existed before this PR, so the suggestion is only about where these exports live: consider a `src/test/helpers/git-repo.mock.ts` for `GIT_ENV` and `initRepo`.

A stray JSDoc meant for `seedKilledSession` (`/** A session whose tmux pane is gone for good — steer/interrupt must refuse it. */`) sits stacked on top of `rolledBackLaunch`'s own doc block, so `seedKilledSession` has no doc. The move kept this byte for byte from base lines 365-378; while the code is being moved anyway, put the line back above `seedKilledSession`.
